verdict.rationale: Build and type-check scaling is a fair question for a compiler-based UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack has no benchmarks, documentation or hands-on reports on how build or `sv check` times scale in large or monorepo codebases. The material on `sv check`, fast Vite dev, ISR and migrating a large app covers adjacent features or runtime performance, not build or type-check scaling.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how the framework's build and type-check times scale in large, multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos
